=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:578-595 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Pipeline `cd` commands are skipped even though Bash can run the last pipeline element in the current shell with `lastpipe` enabled and job control disabled, causing the guard to check a push against the wrong checkout.
  WHY: This can let a push to a merged branch bypass the guard; severity disagrees across reviewers (NIT, MAJOR, and BLOCKER), with BLOCKER highest.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:443-465 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Shell-reader detection checks only the text before the heredoc operator, so `cat <<'EOF' | bash` is treated as data and its body is stripped.
  WHY: Bash executes the heredoc body through the later pipeline shell reader, so a `git push` in the body goes undetected; severity disagrees between MAJOR and BLOCKER, with BLOCKER highest.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:143 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_HEREDOC_OPERATOR_RE` does not recognize escaped delimiters such as `<<\EOF`.
  WHY: The heredoc body remains in the command and can trigger a shell parse confirmation on a routine command; severity disagrees between NIT and MAJOR, with MAJOR highest.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:578-595 (specifically line 594: `if in_pipeline and tokens[0] in ("cd", "pushd", "popd"): continue`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Pipeline cd commands are unconditionally skipped, although `lastpipe` can make a pipeline's final `cd` change the current shell directory.
  WHY: The guard can inspect the wrong checkout's PR history and miss a merged-branch push.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:143 (`_HEREDOC_OPERATOR_RE`), 443-445 (heredoc detection), and the `prefix` parameter at line 445 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The regex misses escaped heredoc delimiters, and shell-reader detection searches only the command prefix before `<<`.
  WHY: `<<\EOF` can trigger a false confirmation, while `cat <<'EOF' | bash` can strip a body containing a `git push` and bypass the guard.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:591 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_guarded_git_invocations` ignores `cd`, `pushd`, and `popd` commands in a pipeline.
  WHY: With `lastpipe` enabled and job control disabled, a pipeline directory change can persist while the guard checks the original working directory.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:457 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_strip_data_heredoc_bodies` detects shell readers only by checking the prefix before `<<`.
  WHY: In `cat <<'EOF' | bash`, the body can contain a `git push` that the guard strips and fails to detect.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:139 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_HEREDOC_OPERATOR_RE` does not support escaped delimiters such as `<<\EOF`.
  WHY: The body remains in the command and can cause an unnecessary confirmation on routine commands.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 461-465 in `_strip_data_heredoc_bodies`; pattern `_SHELL_HEREDOC_READER_RE.search(prefix)` where prefix is `line[:position]` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Shell-reader detection searches only the text before the heredoc operator on the same line.
  WHY: In `cat <<'EOF' | bash`, the body is stripped even though Bash executes it through the pipeline, allowing a `git push` in the body to bypass the guard. The mirror copy at `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:461-465` has the same bug.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:line 143 `_HEREDOC_OPERATOR_RE = re.compile(r"<<(-?)[ \t]*(['\"]?)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\2")`; also `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:2552` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex does not accept a backslash-escaped delimiter, so `<<\EOF` is not recognized as a heredoc operator.
  WHY: An unbalanced quote in the remaining body can trigger the confirmation this change is intended to remove; the cited test enshrines the incorrect behavior.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 580 and 594-595 in `_guarded_git_invocations`; `in_pipeline = operator == "|" or next_operator == "|"` then `if in_pipeline and tokens[0] in ("cd", "pushd", "popd"): continue` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Pipeline `cd`, `pushd`, and `popd` commands are skipped without updating the working directory or marking it unknown.
  WHY: With `lastpipe` enabled and job control disabled, the directory change can persist, so the guard checks the push against the original checkout.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  PROBLEM: Shell-reader detection examines only the command text before the heredoc operator and removes the body in `cat <<'EOF' | bash`.

  PROBLEM: Pipeline `cd` commands are always ignored, although Bash can run the last pipeline element in the current shell with `lastpipe` enabled and job control disabled.
  WHY: The guard checks the push against the original checkout rather than the repository where the push runs.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: _HEREDOC_OPERATOR_RE, line 143; _evaluate_bash, lines 1653-1656 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The heredoc matcher does not recognize an escaped delimiter such as `<<\EOF`.
  WHY: The body remains in `git_view_command`, and an apostrophe in the body can cause a confirmation on a routine command.
